title: Chat agent
description: What the frontend's F1 agent did: its turns and the lake tools it called. CDC of Formula1Frontend.AgentTurn and AgentToolCall (17-agent-traces.mdl), copied from GenAI Commons' traces.

panels.title: Answers
panels.note: Turns of the chat agent, per hour.
panels.query: SELECT date_trunc('hour', StartTime::TIMESTAMP) AS hour, count(*) AS answers FROM formula1frontend.agentturn GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time to answer
panels.note: Seconds per answer, as GenAI Commons measured the agent call; the last row is the latest answer.
panels.query: SELECT StartTime::TIMESTAMP AS t, round(DurationMs / 1000.0, 1) AS seconds FROM formula1frontend.agentturn ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per answer
panels.note: Input and output tokens over all model calls of one answer. Input dominates: every call re-sends the conversation and the tool results.
panels.query: SELECT StartTime::TIMESTAMP AS t, InputTokens + OutputTokens AS tokens FROM formula1frontend.agentturn ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tool calls that failed
panels.note: A failed call is usually a query the agent then corrects.
panels.query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE IsError OR Status NOT LIKE 'Executed%') AS failed FROM formula1frontend.agenttoolcall

panels.title: Which lake tools the agent uses
panels.query: SELECT ToolName, count(*) AS calls FROM formula1frontend.agenttoolcall GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Steps per answer
panels.note: Model calls and tool calls of the latest answers. More model calls than tool calls means the agent read a result and asked again.
panels.query: SELECT left(Question, 60) AS question, ModelCalls AS model_calls, ToolCalls AS tool_calls FROM formula1frontend.agentturn ORDER BY StartTime DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Latest answers
panels.query: SELECT StartTime::TIMESTAMP AS asked, left(Question, 80) AS question, ToolCalls AS tools, round(DurationMs / 1000.0, 1) AS seconds, InputTokens + OutputTokens AS tokens, HasError AS error FROM formula1frontend.agentturn ORDER BY StartTime DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Latest tool calls
panels.note: What the agent asked the lake, joined to the question it was answering through the association's link view.
panels.query: SELECT t.StartTime::TIMESTAMP AS called, t.ToolName AS tool, t.Status AS status, t.DurationMs AS ms, left(t.Input, 120) AS input, left(a.Question, 50) AS for_question FROM formula1frontend.agenttoolcall t LEFT JOIN formula1frontend.agenttoolcall__turn l ON l.id = t.id LEFT JOIN formula1frontend.agentturn a ON a.id = l.target ORDER BY t.StartTime DESC LIMIT 30
